body:
code-server (unmodified upstream, no fork) installed standalone, auth disabled, gated entirely by a new IDUNA reverse proxy (/admin/nock/code/) behind the exact same RequireCookieAuth+iduna.admin chain as every other NOCK admin route -- same Back Office login. Corrected an initial wrong flag guess (--abs-proxy-base-path is for a different code-server feature) before shipping. Live-verified: unauthenticated requests get a real 401. 3 new tests + full suite green. IDUNA e740763.

⚓ ☃
title: VS Code (code-server) as a NOCK tool, gated by IDUNA admin auth (S486)
